title: Empowering Performance: Autonomy, Accountability, & Flexible Work

Join Millie McIntyre, Sr. Director of Buyer Services at IAA, to explore how autonomy, accountability, and flexible scheduling drive engagement, elevate performance, and build trust. Leave with practical strategies to encourage self-management, support professional growth, and design work models that empower employees to thrive.
